entries.message: Tab size in Settings › Appearance is now a slider with nine steps, from Thin to Large, and a thin tab keeps its title readable while losing the room around it. The Space header grows and shrinks with your tabs.

Choose how much room the sidebar keeps between tabs, the address field, pins and section headers with Spacing in Settings › Appearance: None, Tight, Default or Relaxed. It appears in every customization style.
On Mac, the sidebar slides in and out a third faster by default. Choose its speed in Settings › Appearance › Sidebar slide time.
